278306780.description: This large natural agate geode specimen features a polished face that reveals striking blue-gray and white banding with crystal formations at the center. The exterior retains its original rough texture with earthy brown, green, and tan tones. The piece weighs approximately 2.1 lbs and measures about 4 inches tall by 5.5 inches wide. There are price and inventory stickers from Goodwill on one side, and the specimen shows no visible major damage.

278262880.description:
Unopened whole geode packaged for breaking open at home. The tan and cream stone has a bumpy, nodular outer surface with gray mineral speckling and a small pink paint dot on one side. It arrives sealed in clear plastic wrap with a printed card from Stoneworks Lapidary titled Break Your Own Geode, noting that these geodes are found in Morocco and instructing the user to tap moderately with a hammer until they crack open to reveal the crystal structure inside, wrapping the stone in a cloth or wearing safety glasses first. Includes the geode, the wrap and the instruction card. The interior has not been opened, so the crystal formation inside is unknown.

Condition: Unopened and intact. Loose sandy grit and a few small stone crumbs inside the wrap. Small pink paint mark on the surface.

277928851.description:
Various Minerals and Fossils
9.6 lb Specimen Collection Lot
Geodes, Teeth, and Tumbled Stones
Assorted Dimensions
Unsigned
This comprehensive geological collection features a diverse array of specimens ranging from large natural geodes to prehistoric marine fossils. The centerpiece of the lot includes two significant quartz geodes with well-defined crystalline interiors. Additionally, the collection includes three authentic Mosasaurus teeth recovered from Morocco, presented in a specialized display case with educational text regarding the Late Cretaceous marine reptile. The variety of colors and textures makes this an ideal starter set for a young collector or a significant addition to an existing mineral display.
Two large hollow geodes featuring dense white quartz crystal formations, measuring approximately 5-6 inches each
Three fossilized Mosasaurus teeth in original display case from Morocco, dating to the Late Cretaceous period
Wide variety of mineral specimens including Amethyst, Pyrite (Fool's Gold), Jasper, Tiger's Eye, and Calcite
Large hand-knapped obsidian arrowhead and additional small stone points included for historical context
Condition:
The collection is in good overall condition. Geodes remain structurally sound with intact crystalline structures and minimal exterior wear. Mineral specimens show natural variations, inclusions, and textures consistent with geological formations. The Mosasaurus display case is clean and legible. Tumbled and raw stones are clean and ready for display or lapidary use.
